name: EuroStream DuckDB warehouse
role: Warehouse of record: bronze, silver, gold and governance schemas
meaning: The single-file analytical database that holds every medallion table and the governance tables
impact: Main migration source: its 16 tables become Unity Catalog tables in the eurostream catalog
risk: If a deployment points EUROSTREAM_WAREHOUSE_PATH elsewhere, the inventory reflects the default file only

recommendation.reason: Every transform, the API and erasure open this file

name: Render web service eurostream-api
role: Hosted FastAPI + dashboard, free plan, frankfurt
meaning: The hosted copy of the API and dashboard that business users would open
impact: Consumer to re-point at Databricks SQL or replace with a Databricks App
risk: Free plan with ephemeral disk; unauthenticated erasure endpoints are internet-facing

recommendation.reason: Blueprint in repo with secrets for Kafka, Turso, salt

name: Hugging Face Space swadhinbiswas/eurostream
role: Docker-hosted copy of the app pushed from CI
meaning: A second public hosting of the application, on a personal Hugging Face account
impact: Consumer to retire or replace when the serving layer moves
risk: Personal-account hosting of the client app; ownership and access unclear

recommendation.reason: CI workflow deploys it on push

name: EuroStream SQLite event bus
role: Default local message log (topics, consumer offsets)
meaning: The local, file-based stand-in for Kafka that stores every order, click and payment event
impact: Replaced by the target ingestion path; its messages table holds raw PII and must be retired, not copied
risk: If production runs on it rather than Kafka, the real event source is a file with no retention

recommendation.reason: Default backend in config and in the GitHub Actions fallback

name: Turso libSQL replica
role: Cloud dual-write copy of the warehouse tables, read as a fallback
meaning: A hosted SQLite-compatible database that mirrors bronze, silver, gold and governance tables
impact: Retire on the target (Delta replaces it); its PII copy must be erased before decommission
risk: Clear-text bronze PII sits in a cloud DB whose region is unknown; erasure failures there are swallowed

recommendation.reason: Every append and erasure step writes to it when configured

name: Hugging Face dataset swadhinbiswas/eustream
role: Published Parquet lake (silver and gold), public
meaning: A public dataset on Hugging Face that receives the silver and gold Parquet export every four hours
impact: An external consumer and data copy the migration must re-point or shut; in scope for erasure and residency
risk: Pseudonymised customer data is world-readable on a non-EU-pinned host

recommendation.reason: Upload step and public API metadata both observed

name: Local data directory (lake, logs, checkpoints)
role: Parquet lake export, audit/metrics/pipeline JSONL logs
meaning: The folder of files the app writes beside the database: Parquet lake, audit trail, metrics, pipeline log
impact: Each file store is an inventory item; the audit trail moves to a governed table, the rest are rebuilt
risk: Files with customer ids outlive erasure and are cached in GitHub Actions

recommendation.reason: Paths are defaults in config and created at start-up

name: Databricks DEV workspace dbc-9e28c516-33ae
role: Target workspace; already holds a bundle-deployed EuroStream pipeline (catalog eurostream)
meaning: The client's DEV Databricks workspace (AWS us-east-2 metastore) where a first EuroStream port already runs
impact: Migration target; the existing bundle deployment is prior work to reuse or replace
risk: Its source is not in the repo; rebuilding blind duplicates or contradicts what runs there

recommendation.reason: Read live through the CLI, metadata only

name: Aiven Kafka (hosted event bus)
role: Hosted event bus used by Render and the scheduled DAG (SASL_SSL, SCRAM-SHA-256)
meaning: The managed Kafka service that carries the four EuroStream topics when the hosted stack runs
impact: Becomes the streaming source for the target ingestion (Structured Streaming or Lakeflow); host comes from a secret
risk: Host, region and retention are unknown; it may sit outside the EU and keep PII for its retention period

recommendation.reason: Host and region are only in secrets; confirm with the platform owner (OQ-05)

name: AWS MSK eurostream-prod-events
role: Terraform-defined Kafka cluster in eu-central-1, 3 brokers, TLS
meaning: A second Kafka cluster, defined in infrastructure code in Frankfurt, not referenced by the running app config
impact: Decide whether it is the intended production bus; if not, retire it from scope
risk: Planning the wrong Kafka as the source; two buses with no wiring between them

recommendation.reason: Render and CI use Aiven; unclear whether MSK was ever applied (OQ-05)

name: AWS S3 lake bucket ${local.name}-lake
role: Terraform-defined private, versioned object lake in eu-central-1
meaning: A private S3 bucket defined for the lake; the application code never writes to it
impact: Candidate external location for Unity Catalog, or retire if never applied
risk: Versioning keeps deleted objects, which conflicts with erasure if it is used

recommendation.reason: No code path writes to it; confirm it exists (OQ-05)
